reviewNotes: HOLD — UPNG officially offers a five-year MBBS through the School of Medicine and Health Sciences. The official 2026 fee schedule gives Medicine and Health Sciences annual fees of K12,970 for South Pacific students and K26,930 for other international students; it also identifies separate compulsory Taurama MBBS fees. The MBBS page gives a 3.5 GPA Science Foundation Year route and specified quota groups. The current evidence does not establish eligibility for all foreign applicants outside those groups, a complete 2026 MBBS application calendar/documents list, mandatory cost breakdown, clinical placement details, accommodation/support or recognition requirements by target market. It is held pending those facts; the 2025 standalone-medical-university proposal does not alter the current UPNG identity.
